About 71% of Italians said in 2019 that it is very important to have free media without government or state censorship. This comes from my recollection of Pew Research Center's 2019 European survey, which I haven't rechecked. It also fits the team note that Italy's figure was above two-thirds and below four-fifths, so I'm dropping my earlier 61%.

CONFIDENCE: 50
